scope: DS-V4.1 HBM accelerator, TP-96 die 0, position 1,048,575: the DU local steps the W19 model prices, measured in RTL on the golden-checked executor's real operands
operands: tools/dshbm_baseline_measure.py execute --exec-layers L (L1, L2, L20, L24 alone, entering from the W17 golden shard of the layer before; every layer region bit-exact)

L1.engram_mix.domain: serial 0.9 GHz (SU incl. SFU EGATE side pipe)
L1.engram_mix.source: SU N1024/M256 b4r5m4a3 dpi_beh chain L1.engram_mix

L2.index_q.source: SU N1024/M256 b4r5m4a3 dpi_beh chain L2.index_q + ot_hdc_actquant (fp4) quant.json

L20.index_q.source: SU N1024/M256 b4r5m4a3 dpi_beh chain L20.index_q + ot_hdc_actquant (fp4) quant.json

L24.index_q.source: SU N1024/M256 b4r5m4a3 dpi_beh chain L24.index_q + ot_hdc_actquant (fp4) quant.json

L2.index_scores.scaling: cycles = fixed + ceil(keys / 64): one 64-key beat a cycle (4,352 B of FP4 keys + scales a cycle = 5.2 TB/s at 1.2 GHz, above the die's 4 x 1.0 TB/s HBM peak: the scan is HBM-stream-bound, take max(stream, compute) + the fixed part)
L2.index_scores.source: ot_hdc_v41x_idx_array W11, NS2/NK4 x 8 slot windows

L20.index_scores.scaling: cycles = fixed + ceil(keys / 64): one 64-key beat a cycle (4,352 B of FP4 keys + scales a cycle = 5.2 TB/s at 1.2 GHz, above the die's 4 x 1.0 TB/s HBM peak: the scan is HBM-stream-bound, take max(stream, compute) + the fixed part)
L20.index_scores.source: ot_hdc_v41x_idx_array W11, NS2/NK4 x 8 slot windows

L24.index_scores.scaling: cycles = fixed + ceil(keys / 64): one 64-key beat a cycle (4,352 B of FP4 keys + scales a cycle = 5.2 TB/s at 1.2 GHz, above the die's 4 x 1.0 TB/s HBM peak: the scan is HBM-stream-bound, take max(stream, compute) + the fixed part)
L24.index_scores.cand_mask: inside (keep bit per key, -inf out), measured exact
L24.index_scores.source: ot_hdc_v41x_idx_array W11, NS2/NK4 x 8 slot windows

router_top6.source: results/rtl/w19_expert_fetch.json router_topk (cited RTL: 24 beats of 16 scores + 23-cycle tail, 40 real router vectors of the token + 200 random, exact)

unmeasured.why: an HBM table-row read (die 0 owns the hashed ids == 0 mod 96 of the layer's (n-1) x heads hashes), not a compute step; the ids depend only on the token history, so the read can issue at token start like the Engram gathers the W19 composer already takes off path (OFF_PATH_COLL 'engram.'); its latency is an HBM first access (the HBM fork's measured service), not re-measured here
not a separate unit: the indexer array applies the candidate keep bit per key (measured exact on L24, inside index_scores)

pricing_guide.index_q: layers 2, 8, 14, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36: L2/L20/L24 rows (identical, 201 serial cycles: SU RoPE 60 + one-instance FP4 QDQ 141)
pricing_guide.index_scores: n 524,288 (L2, L8, L14): L2.index_scores; n 1,048,576: L20.index_scores (L20) and L24.index_scores (L24/28/32/36, candidate mask applied in the array)
pricing_guide.topk_local: L2/L8: L2.topk_local; L14: L14.topk_local; L20: L20.topk_local; L24/28/32/36: L24.topk_local (full masked stream)
pricing_guide.quant: hc_pre_norm / final_norm: *.attn.quant / *.ffn.quant (5,120, 173 cycles one instance); q_norm_kv_row: q_quant (1,280, 53) and kv_row_qdq (512, 29) are independent (q and kv chains): 53 on the chain if two instances, 82 if one
pricing_guide.route_top6: router_top6 (47 fast cycles, replaces the model's 31.9 + 25.1 ns)
